name: Wave:3
author: abduldotdev
description: Keeps an Elgato Wave:3 USB microphone as the always-working default input: pins its profile and priority in WirePlumber, re-defaults it when it reappears, and adds a bar icon with a one-click reset.

barWidget.description: Elgato Wave:3 mic status (present, default, muted) with a one-click reset
